_summary: Master index of all platform sections. The homepage category cards and the top navigation bar are both built from this file. To add a new section, add an entry here — no other config changes needed.

sections.title: Intro to Data Science
sections.description: What DS is, how it connects to AI and ML, the workflow, and the landscape of roles and tools.

sections.title: Statistics
sections.description: The mathematical foundation everything else is built on — distributions, probability, hypothesis testing.

sections.title: Advanced Statistics
sections.description: Bayesian thinking, experimental design, statistical power and the deeper reasoning behind inference.

sections.title: Machine Learning
sections.description: How models learn, the core algorithms, evaluation metrics and the bias-variance tradeoff.

sections.title: Advanced ML
sections.description: Ensembles, boosting, clustering, dimensionality reduction, time series and neural network basics.

sections.title: Data Warehousing
sections.description: Data warehouses, schemas, ETL pipelines and the architecture behind analytical systems.

sections.title: Data Mining
sections.description: Finding patterns in large datasets — association rules, anomaly detection, text mining.

sections.title: Big Data
sections.description: What happens when data outgrows one machine — distributed computing, Spark, streaming.

sections.title: DBMS & Data Warehousing
sections.description: Databases, SQL, normalization, data warehouses, schemas and the ETL pipeline.
